sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: The candidate is deterministic-valid and faithfully encodes the COMPLETE DIRECT_STATIC contract: authoritative owners and paths are respected, required operands and relationships are present, bottom-versus-side applicability is selected through structuralLocation, bottom load-case orientation is enforced without requiring it for side members, the demand comparison is correctly paired per member load case, and the derived plastic-strength relationship uses a tolerance scaled from the expected midspan result. No vocabulary matcher activation is needed.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows:
Deterministic validation prevents acceptance. Fix: Unknown canonical benchmark IRI(s): https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#GeneratedShape_I2_031_LoadCase, https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#GeneratedShape_I2_031_Ship, https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#GeneratedShape_I2_031_StructuralMember
Semantic validator feedback: Repair the deterministic vocabulary error by replacing the three nltl:GeneratedShape_I2_031_* IRIs with blank-node helper shapes (they are not canonical vocabulary terms), while using the supplied canonical structuralMember and loadCase classes where class constraints are needed. Add required presence for every declared operand and relationship that must exist, including patchLoad, frameProfileType, structural members, and each member's load case as applicable. Preserve the authoritative owners: patchLoad, plasticCollapseMechanism, and frameProfileType on ship; structuralLocation, transverseFrameOrientation, plasticStrength, and midspanPlasticCollapseLoad on structuralMember; and combinedShearAndBendingDemand and loadPatchOrientation on loadCase. Do not require transverseFrameOrientation or loadPatchOrientation universally: encode the bottom-versus-side and bottom-only orientation applicability using structuralLocation as the branch selector, requiring the side branch to be transverse and the bottom branch to use loadPatchHeightParallelToFrame, without allowing missing selector evidence to pass. Keep the per-member demand <= plasticStrength comparison paired through each load case, but replace the exact decimal equality between plasticStrength and midspanPlasticCollapseLoad with a tolerance scaled from the expected midspan result; exact equality is not valid for this derived result. The final graph must include all COMPLETE dependency-contract operands, results, relationships, paths, and applicability semantics and must have deterministicValidation.valid true.

The candidate is deterministic-valid and faithfully encodes the COMPLETE DIRECT_STATIC contract: authoritative owners and paths are respected, required operands and relationships are present, bottom-versus-side applicability is selected through structuralLocation, bottom load-case orientation is enforced without requiring it for side members, the demand comparison is correctly paired per member load case, and the derived plastic-strength relationship uses a tolerance scaled from the expected midspan result. No vocabulary matcher activation is needed.
